UI consistency audit complete.

## Result: CONVERGED — 8th consecutive 0-fix UI-consistency audit

I ran a definitive code-level grep over all of `client/src` plus a Playwright runtime spot-check. **Zero inconsistencies found, zero fixes needed, zero commits** (charter: if it works, leave it alone).

### What I checked

| Audit | Method | Result |
|---|---|---|
| **Icons** | Grep all imports + runtime SVG scan | 100% `@heroicons/react/24/outline`. 0 solid/lucide/react-icons/fontawesome/material. Runtime: Dashboard 70/70, Estimates 38/38, Settings 31 — all heroicon `viewBox 0 0 24 24`, 0 foreign |
| **Forms** | Grep + runtime | 0 native `<select>`, 0 `<input type=date/time>` anywhere (CustomSelect + DatePicker enforced) |
| **Modal animation** | Grep inline `animation:` | Only LeadDetail.jsx:1806/1933, both byte-equal to canonical `.modal-backdrop>.glass` (200ms ease-apple) |
| **Buttons** | Runtime computed radii | Group to design tokens; `14/12px` & `10/8px` are CSS border-radius clamp artifacts (known non-bugs) |

### Why so little churn this run
Only 3 `client/src` files changed since the last audit, all previously audited:
- **LeadDetail.jsx** — the `b689994` checkpoint committed the Esc-to-close handler from the prior run. That's keyboard-nav, not visual drift; its modal animations are still canonical.
- **EstimatesView.jsx** (`aab6753`) and **ImportLeadsModal.jsx** (`e3b548b`) — unchanged since they were last verified.

### Non-bugs confirmed (do not "fix")
- Button radii `14px/12px` / `10px/8px` = CSS clamping on short elements.
- The single un-classed Settings input is the global TopBar Cmd-K search (`.topbar__search`), present app-wide and consistent — not a page form field.

Deliverable written to `C:\tmp\ui-audit-results.txt`; resume updated. The app is now converged on every QA axis (UI-consistency 8 audits, backend 11 runs, tablet-768px sweep 100%). The next run only needs to re-audit if the developer adds **new** component files — the recurring drift vector is a new modal with a non-canonical inline animation.
